correctness.rationale: For each partition, the pair-sign group has four projective classes and preserves every diagonal defining quadric and all three product coordinates. The inspected verifier independently enumerates all 15 pairings and checks these invariances and determinant \(+1\). Auel--Singer's degree-four map has generic fibers equal to the pair-sign orbits, so the target function field is exactly the invariant subfield. Each nontrivial projective sign class changes an even number of coordinates, hence fixes the Poincaré-residue holomorphic two-form; the action therefore lifts symplectically through rational double points. The standard finite symplectic quotient theorem for K3 surfaces gives only rational double points and a K3 minimal resolution. Birationality of the two smooth K3 resolutions then implies isomorphism.
